name: multi-pattern-match
title: Multi-pattern Match
description: Aho–Corasick matching of thousands of patterns in one pass, for scanning logs and payloads for indicators of compromise.

usage.python:
from kura_rs import multi_pattern_match

matcher = multi_pattern_match.Matcher(iocs)

for hit in matcher.find_all(payload):
    alert(hit.pattern, hit.offset)
